name: Ayanna Everstride
summary: In Aldrassil, Ayanna Everstride guides young kaldorei in the hunter’s way. She teaches marksmanship, tracking, and survival beneath the World Tree.

sections.title: A Mentor in Shadowglen
sections.body: In Shadowglen, Ayanna Everstride trains newly awakened kaldorei hunters within Aldrassil. To the night elves, hunters guard the sacred forests. Their work reaches beyond trapping or shooting from afar. Ayanna teaches young hunters early martial skills, ranged combat, and ways to survive Teldrassil’s perilous woods.

faq.answer: Ayanna Everstride trains novice night elf hunters in Aldrassil, within Shadowglen on Teldrassil. She teaches basic combat and survival in the wild.

faq.q: Where can I find Ayanna Everstride?
faq.answer: You can find Ayanna Everstride inside Aldrassil, the massive hollowed tree settlement in Shadowglen, at the heart of Teldrassil.
Early training brings new night elf hunters to Ayanna. Their first instructors may give them an Etched Sigil, and Ayanna then teaches the basics to aspiring woodland rangers.

angles.text: As a hunter starting in Shadowglen, you can turn to Ayanna Everstride for your first lessons in weapon handling, tracking, and wilderness survival.
As a night elf, you find Ayanna within Aldrassil’s sacred hollows. She prepares raw recruits to defend the surrounding forest from encroaching corruption and help safeguard the young World Tree.
